purpose: Record outbound exposure of Reciprocal Agency artifacts to external projects so later apparent convergence can be provenance-adjusted.

field_definitions.target: External repository, wiki, paper, forum, or other surface.
field_definitions.contribution_url: Canonical URL for the submitted contribution.
field_definitions.exposed_artifacts: Exact Reciprocal Agency files/claims exposed to the target.
field_definitions.status: drafted, submitted, accepted, rejected, superseded, or withdrawn.
field_definitions.independence_effect: How later evidence from the target should be treated after exposure.
